item.title: Kagawa Events 2026: Takamatsu Festival Fireworks, Konpira & Art Islands
item.description: Kagawa, Japan’s smallest prefecture, punches far above its size — home of Sanuki udon, the pilgrimage shrine of Konpira-san, the celebrated Ritsurin Garden, and the “art islands” of the Seto Inland Sea. Its 2026 event calendar centres on a lively summer festival with fireworks over Takamatsu’s harbour, alongside year-round island art and one of Japan’s finest strolling gardens. This guide gathers the events worth planning a 2026 trip around, with a month-by-month calendar at the end.
